text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Thursday, January 10, 2018 Posted by admin on January 10th, 2019
There are no Dow stocks at 52 week highs. There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -70 points.
Wednesday the Dow was up +91.67 (+0.39%) at 23,879.12.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +2.36%.
There were 19 Dow stocks up Wednesday.
The Dow stock winners Wednesday were led by Apple (AAPL) +1.70%, Microsoft (MSFT) +1.43% and Chevron (CVX) +1.34%.
The Dow stock losers Wednesday were led by Verizon (VZ) -2.28%, Disney (DIS) -1.92% and Procter & Gamble (PG) -1.63%.
The Dow needs to close at or above 23,971.42 to emerge from correction.
Boeing (BA) rose 1 percent before the bell after Morgan Stanley upgraded shares to “overweight” and Susquehanna Financial Group initiated coverage with a positive rating.
European stocks are lower and Asian markets ended mostly lower.
The national average price of gasoline is up five-tenths of a cent at $2.235 per gallon.
